light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

The man is the person of the last input image (a close-up of his real face): EXACTLY that face, same dark curly black hair, same short salt-and-pepper beard, about 50 years old. He wears grey rubber work gloves. clips.text: Bueno, a la otra mitad. Esta vez la hacemos despacio, y te voy diciendo cada detalle.
clips.action: He pulls the safety glasses down over his eyes and waves the friend who films toward the old right half of the floor.

clips.text: Todo lo que en el resumen te dije rápido, ahora con los detalles que hacen la diferencia.
clips.action: He crouches next to a chalk circle and sets the chisel on its edge, speaking to the friend who films.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the hammer strikes the angled chisel, flat grey chips peel off the loose patch until a clean hole with firm edges remains.

clips.text: Mira este pedazo. Por arriba parecía entero, y por abajo estaba suelto. Si le echas encima, se levanta junto con lo nuevo.
clips.action: He turns the broken piece of old cement over to show its dusty loose underside, then taps it and lets it drop into a bucket.

clips.text: Los bordes de los huecos, que no queden en punta fina. Un borde firme, para que la mezcla tenga de dónde agarrarse.
clips.action: He runs a gloved finger along the edge of the hole, then knocks off a thin feathered edge with the chisel.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the broom sweeps the dust and chips away with strong strokes, then a wet scrubbing brush scrubs the fine dust off the old cement.

clips.text: Si hay grasa, aceite de auto o restos de pintura, se friega con agua y detergente, o se raspa. Donde hay grasa, nada se pega.
clips.action: He crouches beside a dark oily stain on the old floor, squirts some dish soap from a bottle on it and scrubs hard with the brush, foam forming.

clips.text: Y el musgo verde de los rincones, lo mismo: cepillo y agua, hasta que se vea el cemento limpio.
clips.action: He moves to the corner by the wall where there is green moss on the floor and scrubs it with the brush and a splash of water.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the fine spray of the hose soaks the dry old cement, the surface darkening as it drinks the water.

clips.text: Si tu patio es grande, no lo hagas todo en un día. Por paños: uno por vez, y cada paño completo, de la lechada a la escoba.
clips.action: He puts the hose down and marks out imaginary squares over the floor with his flat hand, one after the other.

clips.text: Mientras se moja, las guías: dos listones derechos, sobre dos montoncitos de mezcla, que marcan la altura de la carpeta.
clips.action: He lays a straight wooden batten on two small mounds of mortar on the wet floor and presses it down, then lays a second one parallel.

clips.text: Y la pendiente, que no se te olvide. El agua tiene que correr hacia el desagüe, igual que antes. Nunca hacia la casa.
clips.action: He points toward the small drain grate in the corner of the patio, then away from the back door of the house, drawing the slope in the air with his hand.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the bubble of the spirit level slides and settles just off-centre as a gloved finger taps the batten.
